title: Present Tenses for the Future
completion_message: ¡Buen trabajo! Ya sabes cómo usar los tiempos presentes para hablar del futuro en inglés corporativo.

parts.visual:
En inglés, a menudo usamos tiempos presentes para hablar del futuro. 
Present Continuous para citas o acuerdos confirmados (Arrangements). Ej: I am meeting the client tomorrow at 10 (Me reuniré con el cliente mañana a las 10).
parts.audio: In English, we often use present tenses to talk about the future. We use the Present Continuous for fixed arrangements or appointments. For example: I am meeting the client tomorrow at 10.

parts.visual: Present Simple para horarios oficiales, trenes, vuelos o eventos programados. Ej: The train leaves at 8 PM (El tren sale a las 8). The conference starts on Monday (La conferencia empieza el lunes).
parts.audio: We use the Present Simple for official schedules, trains, flights, or scheduled events. For example: The train leaves at 8 PM. The conference starts on Monday.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta (Present Simple para horarios, Present Continuous para citas).

questions.question: I ____ the manager tomorrow morning. (Cita confirmada).
questions.explanation: Cita personal/confirmada: Present Continuous (am seeing = voy a ver / me reuniré con).

questions.question: The flight to London ____ at 6:30 AM. (Horario oficial).
What time ____ the meeting start tomorrow? (Horario programado).
questions.explanation: Pregunta de horario: Present Simple (What time does it start?).

questions.question: We ____ dinner with the investors tonight. (Plan/Cita confirmada).
questions.explanation: Plan social/Cita confirmada: Present Continuous (are having).

questions.question: The new store ____ next Friday. (Apertura oficial/Evento programado).
questions.explanation: Un evento oficial programado (como una apertura) suele usar Present Simple.

questions.question: I can't talk right now. I ____ to New York tomorrow and I need to pack. (Plan personal).
questions.explanation: Plan personal confirmado: Present Continuous (am flying = voy a volar/volaré).

questions.question: ____ you working next Saturday? (Pregunta sobre arreglo personal).
The conference ____ at 5 PM on Sunday. (Horario oficial).
questions.explanation: Horario de un evento: Present Simple (finishes).

questions.question: They ____ the new product next month. (Cita/Plan de la empresa confirmada).
questions.explanation: Un plan futuro de la empresa confirmado: are launching.

questions.question: What time ____ your train arrive? (Horario de transporte).
questions.explanation: Transporte = Present Simple (does your train arrive).

questions.question: She ____ a presentation tomorrow at 2 PM. (Arreglo personal confirmado).
questions.explanation: Plan personal: is giving (dará / va a dar).

questions.question: Our bus ____ in 10 minutes! Hurry up! (Horario).
I ____ a day off on Monday. (Arreglo con el jefe).
questions.explanation: Acuerdo personal: am taking (me voy a tomar un día).

questions.question: The movie ____ at 8:15. Don't be late. (Horario de cine).
We ____ to a new office next week. (Mudanza confirmada).
questions.explanation: Arreglo firme: are moving (nos mudaremos / nos vamos a mudar).

questions.question: ____ she attending the workshop on Friday? (Arreglo personal).
The bank ____ at 4 PM. (Horario de apertura/cierre).
I ____ play tennis with John tomorrow. (Cita confirmada).
My contract ____ next December. (Dato fijo/Oficial).
Who ____ you meeting for lunch? (Plan personal).
questions.explanation: Present continuous: Who are you meeting...?
